claims.content: To capture and maintain master details of every distributor, including their unique code, name, business type, address, contact information, and status, to enable tracking of sales and distributions.

goal.raw_text: To capture and maintain master details of every distributor, including their unique code, name, business type, address, contact information, and status, to enable tracking of sales and distributions.

claims.content: The VMU User must be logged into the Voucher Management System (VMUS).
The VMU User must have the necessary user privileges and access rights to create, edit, or view distributor master information.
The 'Distributor Master Information' module of the system must be accessible and operational.
The VMU User initiates the process to add a new distributor record, update an existing distributor's details, or view distributor information within the 'Distributor Master Information' module.

trigger.raw_text: The VMU User initiates the process to add a new distributor record, update an existing distributor's details, or view distributor information within the 'Distributor Master Information' module.

claims.content: The VMU User navigates to the 'Distributor Master Information' module.
The system presents options to add a new distributor record, edit an existing one, or view details.
If adding a new record, the user selects 'New'. If editing, the user selects 'Edit' after choosing a distributor. If viewing, the user double-clicks on a distributor in the grid.
The system displays the data entry form for Distributor Master Information.

The user enters or modifies the required fields: Distributor Code (unique), Name of the distributor, Type of business (e.g., hospital/pharmacy/NGO), Proprietor Name, Designation, Address (Street/Road, Sub District, County, Sub County and Village or Town), Contact No, Email Id, and Status (active/deactivate).

The system validates the entered data, checking for mandatory fields (marked with *) and ensuring the Distributor ID is not duplicated. If a duplicate name is detected, the system issues a warning message.
Upon successful validation, the user saves the record.
The system stores the distributor information in the database and confirms the save operation.
The system allows the user to print the distributor master details.

The system provides a provision to view the Sales History of a particular distributor by double-clicking on the grid, displaying summary details such as Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, Balance Qty, and other required details.

If the system detects a duplicate name during entry, it gives a warning message asking the user to have a duplicate name or change the name; for better reporting purposes, it is suggested to have a differentiating indicator on the name.
Deleting records is allowed only if no child records are created.
